title: Put the Dialogue in Order
ringkas: Menyusun percakapan dari sapaan sampai penutup
goals: memakai petunjuk **pertanyaan dan jawaban** untuk menentukan urutan

lesson.text: Dalam dialog, urutan ditentukan oleh **pertanyaan dan jawaban**, kata ganti, serta ungkapan pembuka dan penutup. Ketuk baris dialog sesuai urutan percakapan yang wajar.

lesson.title: 1. Petunjuk urutan dialog
table: [[Where are you from? — I'm from Bali.]]
Kata ganti merujuk ke kalimat sebelumnya
[[Do you like pizza? — Yes, I love it.]]

examples.en: [[A: Hi! B: Hello! A: How are you? B: Fine, thanks. A: See you later.]]
examples.id: A: Hai! B: Halo! A: Apa kabar? B: Baik, terima kasih. A: Sampai nanti.

lesson.title: Cari pasangan pertanyaan–jawaban
lesson.text: Cocokkan setiap pertanyaan dengan jawabannya lebih dulu, lalu susun pasangan itu menurut alur: sapaan, topik, penutup.

items: Sapaan di awal, penutup di akhir.
Pertanyaan diikuti jawaban.
Kata ganti merujuk ke ujaran sebelumnya.
Terima kasih setelah bantuan.

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: Hello, Rani!
Hi, Budi! How are you?
I'm fine, thanks. And you?
I'm good too. See you in class!
See you!

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: Excuse me, where is the library?
It is on the second floor.
Is there an elevator?
Yes, it is next to the stairs.
Thank you very much.
practice.exp: Bertanya lokasi, jawaban, pertanyaan lanjutan, jawaban, terima kasih.

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: What would you like to drink?
I'd like an orange juice, please.
Would you like some ice?
Yes, please.
Here you are. Enjoy!

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: Good morning. Can I help you?
Yes, I'd like to buy a notebook.
What size do you want?
A small one, please.
That's two dollars.

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: Hello. This is Tom speaking.
Hello, Tom. It is Dina.
Are you free this weekend?
Yes, I am. Why?
Let's go to the cinema!
practice.exp: Telepon: pembuka, sapaan, pertanyaan, jawaban, ajakan.

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: What time does the film start?
It starts at seven.
Shall we meet at six thirty?
Good idea. See you there.
See you!

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: Do you have a pen I can borrow?
Sure, here you are.
Thank you. I'll give it back soon.
No problem.

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: What's the matter, Dina?
I have a headache.
You should rest and drink some water.
Thanks for the advice.
Get well soon!
practice.exp: Menanyakan masalah, keluhan, saran, terima kasih, doa.

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: Hi, I'm new here.
Welcome! My name is Rani.
I'm Tom. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too. Let me show you the classroom.
practice.exp: Perkenalan: kata awal, sambutan, nama, tindak lanjut.

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: Could you tell me the time, please?
It is half past four.
Oh, I'm late for my class!
Run, then! Good luck!

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: Would you like to join our team?
I'd love to. What sport do you play?
We play football on Saturdays.
That sounds great. See you on Saturday!

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: Is this seat free?
Yes, please sit down.
Thank you. Are you going to Bandung too?
Yes, I am. My stop is the last one.
practice.exp: Meminta izin duduk, jawaban, obrolan, jawaban.

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: Hello, I'd like to book a room for two nights.
Certainly. What date would you like to arrive?
On Friday, the tenth.
A double room is fifty dollars a night.
That's fine. I'll take it.
practice.exp: Pemesanan kamar: permintaan, tanggal, jawaban, harga, keputusan.

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: Can you help me with my homework?
Of course. Which subject is it?
It's English. I don't understand this exercise.
Let's read the question together.
Oh, now I understand. Thank you!
practice.exp: Meminta bantuan, persetujuan, masalah, tindakan, terima kasih.

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: What did you do last weekend?
I visited my grandparents.
Did you have a good time?
Yes, we cooked lunch together.
That sounds lovely.
practice.exp: Menanyakan akhir pekan, jawaban, tindak lanjut, penjelasan, tanggapan.

practice.q: Susun baris dialog berikut menjadi percakapan yang wajar.
items: Sorry I'm late.
That's all right. The meeting has just started.
Thank you. What did I miss?
Only the introduction. Please sit down.
